message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest and most popular farmers’ market in the city, drawing hundreds of thousands of visitors each year. The market is open year‑round on Saturdays, Sundays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays, and it’s located at 14th Street and Union Square.
